subject: Escalation: accelerator swap + surcharge waiver for Thermion reservation hold
messages:
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@thermion.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Immediate capacity need & term question

Hi Mina / Marissa —

We have a product event that will drive a sustained traffic spike 11/1–11/21. Our forecasting shows a 4x token volume increase; current H100 reservation won’t cover sustained peaks. We’d like to request: (1) temporary allocation of 6 H100-like accelerators (or compatible L40S if H100 not available) on a reservation hold for 3 months, (2) a waiver of standard overage surcharges for the first two weeks of the spike while we transition clients, and (3) a 20% credit against committed term if the temporary SKU swap/hold triggers a downgrade in baseline throughput.

Attached is a rolling demand spreadsheet. Can you advise whether you can place a reservation hold and where we stand on pricing concessions? We’re ready to sign a short amendment/DocuSign if needed.

Thanks,
Elaine
Head of Platform, Thermion.ai
Attachments: Thermion_Demand_Spreadsheet.xlsx

On Wed, Oct 28, 2026 at 10:05 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Thermion’s ask. Key asks: temp allocation of H100 family capacity (3–6 units), reservation hold for 3 months, waive overage surcharge first 2 weeks, and a 20% term credit if baseline commit is affected.

Mina —

We ran a quick check with infra: H100 capacity in us-west is tight the week of 11/1 but we can provide a transient H100-equivalent allocation by pooling across dedicated nodes (will add ~ $28k incremental cost for first 30 days). If we fallback to L40S family the perf delta is ~12–18% for their model mix; pricing should be lower.

Recommendation: approve a reservation hold for 3 months with the following executive concessions if you sign off:
- One-time waiver of standard overage surcharge for first 14 days (monitoring gated).
- Temporary SKU mix allowed (up to 50% L40S substitution) with a visible performance SLA and credit mechanics (if throughput drops >15% measured on our benchmarks, they receive a one-time 15% credit against month 1 invoice).
- Decline the blanket 20% term credit — instead offer a capped concession: up to $40k credit applied pro-rata across first two billing cycles if SKU substitution materially degrades baseline.

I can draft the short exec memo and P&L impact.

-Marissa
Director, Deal Desk
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: Thermion reservation hold + surcharge waiver

Lauren —

We need an executive sign-off on a nonstandard concession for Thermion.ai (Deal TH-2026-137). Summary: customer asks for 3 month reservation hold that includes temporary H100-class capacity (up to 6 accelerators), with a request to waive overage surcharges for their initial 14-day spike window and a 20% term concession.

Our recommended approval (to limit precedent and P&L risk):
- Approve reservation hold for 3 months with mixed-sku substitution allowed up to 50% (H100 <-> L40S).
- Approve a one-time waiver of overage surcharges for the first 14 calendar days, conditional on usage monitoring and a mandatory mitigation playbook (autoscale limits + throttling rules).
- Approve a conditional credit cap of $40,000 applied across the first two invoices if objective perf tests on Redwood test harness show >15% throughput regression attributable to SKU substitution.

Costs/impact: expected incremental infra cost ~$28k first 30 days; potential revenue deferral but reduces churn risk. This asks for an exec signoff because it includes a waiver of standard surcharge policy and a nonstandard credit cap.

Requested decision: Approve / Deny / Modify. If approved, I’ll request Deal Desk to prepare amendment language and a DocuSign.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Product Finance (Deal Desk)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-30T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Thermion reservation hold + surcharge waiver

Karthik / team —

Approved with modifications. I appreciate the P&L guardrails. My decisions:
1) Reservation hold for up to 3 months approved. Allow mixed-sku substitution (up to 50%) but require an explicit fallback model and automated routing to lower-cost pools when latency targets exceed SLO thresholds.
2) Waive overage surcharges for the first 14 days, but require that the customer enables our burst-mitigation features and grants read-only access to their usage dashboards for the monitoring period.
3) Replace the $40k credit cap with a tiered remediation: if perf regression >=15% -> 15% credit on month 1 invoice; if regression >=25% -> 30% credit on month 1 invoice, capped at $60k. This gives us flexibility while protecting the customer.

Please draft the amendment with these terms and push to DocuSign. Copy legal for standard indemnities.

-Lauren
VP, Commercial Operations
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@thermion.ai>, salesops@thermion.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, brad.mallory@gcp-partners.com
Date: 2026-10-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Escalation: accelerator swap + surcharge waiver for Thermion reservation hold

Elaine —

Thanks for the patience. Executive decision (approved with standard guardrails):
- We will place a 3-month reservation hold and provision up to 6 accelerators with mixed-sku substitution (up to 50% L40S).
- We will waive overage surcharges for the initial 14 days conditional on Thermion enabling Redwood burst-mitigation and granting read-only usage access.
- Performance remediation credit tiers: >=15% regression -> 15% credit month 1; >=25% regression -> 30% credit month 1, capped at $60k.

Next steps: Marissa will draft an amendment and DocuSign packet. We need your countersignature on the amendment and confirmation that your infra team will enable read-only usage access. Brad (GCP partner) — please coordinate any cloud-side capacity mapping.

Appreciate the collaboration — we want you launched for the event.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
